Package meta1

Class RMIGateway

java.lang.Object
java.rmi.server.RemoteObject
java.rmi.server.RemoteServer
java.rmi.server.UnicastRemoteObject
meta1.RMIGateway
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Remote, RMIGatewayBarrelsInterface, RMIGatewayClientsInterface, RMIGatewayDownloadersInterface
public class RMIGateway extends UnicastRemoteObject implements RMIGatewayDownloadersInterface, RMIGatewayBarrelsInterface, RMIGatewayClientsInterface
The RMIGateway class represents the gateway for the RMI-based search engine system. It implements the RMIGatewayDownloadersInterface, RMIGatewayBarrelsInterface, and RMIGatewayClientsInterface interfaces. This class is responsible for managing the URL queue, interacting with barrels, and performing search and query operations.

    • main

      public static void main(String[] args)
      The main method is the entry point of the RMIGateway application. It loads the configurations from a properties file, creates the necessary RMI registries, and adds a default URL to the queue if provided.
      Parameters:
      args - The command line arguments. The first argument should be the path to the properties file.
